title: Stale include!() comments in the five files w-b3c1 changes: correct them after it lands
outcome: Follow-up to w-54bc72cb22b2 (Greg's request, 3ad04090 #36: comments that still describe the include!() assembly). Files carrying such a comment were left out of that item's candidate a4727fba, on the coordinator's condition (30a7a691 #54) that it touch no file w-b3c1's candidate changed. w-b3c1 has landed (b35c79d1), so the comment-only correction is made now, as one batch with w-533ba410e0c7 (coordinator #143/#145), to three of them: src/main.rs (lines 14-17: 'The crate still compiles as one module … and the Telegram relay fragments named below'; main.rs now includes nothing), src/codex_discovery.rs:13 and src/persisted_state.rs:16 ('Extracted from state.rs into its own `include!()` fragment'). Moved out of this item on the coordinator's word (#145): src/persist.rs:24-25 ('The crate still compiles as one `include!()`-assembled module, so no visibility changes are required'), because slice C converts persist.rs's own includes next and its comment is corrected once, after that, in slice C's comment follow-up; and src/tests/mod.rs:8 ('include!-based refactors'), which w-cf04bb45392e also changes, filed as its own item to do after w-cf04 lands. The header comments of src/instructions.rs and src/review.rs already say "imported" on master (landed in fe5f485f). The prepared wording is in the scratch script .tmp/include-to-mod/src-fixes.cjs.
acceptance: This item's contribution to the candidate commit changes only comments in src/main.rs, src/codex_discovery.rs and src/persisted_state.rs; every other path the commit changes belongs to another item, whose contribution is recorded with it.
In those three files no comment describes a file that is now a module as an include!() fragment, or the crate as one module assembled by include!().
Each corrected comment keeps what was historically correct in it: which file the code was extracted from and why.
With comments removed, each file of this item's contribution is token-for-token identical to its base; the token comparison is recorded on the item.
The header comments of src/instructions.rs and src/review.rs say that what other files use is imported at the crate root, not re-exported.
No test reads or pins source text for this change.
